items.title: Fear Us
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Are you afraid of the dark? These monsters want you to fear them and like when you scream! With these skins you can become a scary creature and haunt your friends!

- 12 scary monster skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: Farm
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
Put your adorable overalls on and let's go farming! This skin pack is perfect for roleplaying as a farmer or barnyard animal.

- 10 farm themed skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug

items.title: Nordic Kingdom
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Welcome to the Nordic Kingdom! Become the mightiest viking in the kingdom and journey through the village with your friends. Whether you've always dreamed of being the king or queen of a glorious country, or have wanted to roleplay inside of a castle, this beautiful kingdom is perfect for you!

+ An amazing castle!
+ Tons of houses to explore!
+ By Street Studios

items.title: Airport City
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Would you like to be a pilot? If so, this map is perfect for you! You'll have a great piloting experience on this map with a massive airport, city, and many different vehicles! It's time to show off your piloting skills!

+ Different planes, helicopters, and airport vehicles
+ 2000x2000 custom terrain with 2 airports, a town and a city
+ 6 skins
+ By Mirevon Studios

items.title: Floral Fashion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Flowers are in fashion! Feel the vibe of nature on your skin! Shine on your friends in style with Floral Fashion!

+ 8 unique role-playing skins
+ 1 free skin!
+ By 4theSenpai

items.title: Sweet Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
These teen skins are as sweet as candy! Pick up some sweet and colorful skins to stand out. With fun and modern designs, these skins are perfect on any server, or for playing any game mode.

- 12 cute skins
- Candy themed
- Perfect for teens
- Cool and colorful

items.title: Anime Demons HD
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Meet the group of teen anime demons that you don't want to mess with. They are dangerous and very fashionable. Join them and have fun with their amazing style. Show your horns!
- Anime inspired 
- Anime fun!
- 10 HD Skins

items.title: Neko Neko
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Meet fancy cats in town! Learn the city's fun ways and get to know the biggest Neko family in the Minecraft realm. Play anime games or watch anime marathons all day long and become the coolest weeb! Enjoy all of the K-Pop bands in the city. We love cats! 

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 Neko-themed skins 
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Crazy Anime
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
A new trend has hit the town: Anime! Discover a new Minecraft realm full of anime vibes on every street! Speed down the highway and become the most rebellious teen. Try new outfits every day and become the craziest among your friends while showing your hidden talents. Get ready!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 anime-themed skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Cartoon Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
There's no imposters here, these are definitely real mobs! Offering a cartoon style that looks like they were pulled straight off the page. Featuring some of the most iconic hostile mobs you love to love.

+ 10 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Future Robots
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Future robots are here now! Great for any sci-fi role-playing!

~ 12 HD skins
~ Modern colorful look 
By Norvale and Milkbox Studios

items.title: Lucky One Block Challenge
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Feeling lucky? Break a mystery block and another instantly replaces it. Each break can bring rewards or chaos. Use collected materials to shape the world around you.

217 possible outcomes
3 event types
Truly random events
8 languages supported
Sky‑island gameplay
3 skins

One block with a lucky twist!

items.title: Cute Demons
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Horns, but make it fashion!

Perfect for a stylish picnic in the Nether or shopping in the city. Wearing the latest luxury looks, these cute demons set their own trends and look good while doing it!

- 12 unique skins
- Great for roleplaying with friends

items.title: Skyblock Jars
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Take to the skies, and complete your skyblock journey with a huge twist!

- Over 25 uniquely filled jars
- A variety of mobs and chests to find
- Unique themed areas, including ancient temples and a volcano

items.title: Wild Onesies
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Go wild with these cute animal onesies! Be a dangerous dinosaur, a silly monkey, or a peaceful panda. Wear these skins with your friends to match and explore your Minecraft world!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Collect all animal or onesie skin packs!

items.title: Ducks!
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Do ducks dress up? They do now! Be the talk of all your friends with this quack-ing duck skin pack! There’s a duck for every occasion. Get suited up in a fancy Duck-exdo or take one large step for duck-kind with Space Duck!

* 10 different Ducks to choose from!
* Quack Quack

items.title: Fruity Friends: Pomegranate
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Juicy and rich, grab these precious pomegranate friends to make your day even better.

-10 unique skins
-by Xaphan

items.title: Pixel Mobs HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These mobs are breaking apart! Dress up in an interesting optical illusion based pattern that showcases nine popular hostile mobs. Every twist and turn you make will look like your skin is moving!

+ 9 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Cottage Core HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Enjoy farming, mushroom picking, and other woodland adventures while wearing this aesthetic fashion. Forest colors, flowers, mushrooms, frogs etc. included.

+ 14 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: LUCKY BLOCKS!
items.creator: Chunklabs
items.description:
Survival with Lucky Blocks! This map offers you a new experience to your usual survival adventure! Craft and open blocks, get either lucky or unlucky outcomes and use the loot you get to your advantage!
+ 100+ custom block outcomes
+ Craft or find them throughout the world
+ Inspired from the original lucky block mod
+ Play alone or with friends

items.title: Craftable Mob Houses
items.creator: Cubed Creations
items.description:
Minecraft survival but you can craft mob houses! All your favorite mobs such as the wolf, panda, pig, bee, fox and more are added in the world! See which crafting recipe you need, collect all the required items and place your new mob base! Every mob house is already full of furniture so you can move in immediately!

+Custom crafting recipes!
+Including 12 mobs buildings!

items.title: Furniture Mashup
items.creator: Mythicus
items.description:
Explore the world of beautiful Paradise Island with over 450 pieces of furniture! Buy houses, run from the paparazzi, and ride around in awesome cars, boats, and helicopters. Decorate to your heart's content!
+ Multiplayer
+ 8 skins
+ 25 vehicles 
+ 10 achievements

- Mythicus Studios

items.title: Zombies: Tower Defense
items.creator: HorizonBlocks
items.description:
The zombies try to escape the graveyard. Stop them by fighting with your towers! 
Fight the zombies with traps in three difficulties. 
Become the hero of the village in this Tower Defense minigame! 

+ 10 ZOMBIES (3 BOSSES) 
+ 6 DIFFERENT TOWERS WITH SPECIAL ABILITIES
+ OWN MUSIC 
+ 6 TRAPS 
+ 4 SKINS (1 free)
+ ACHIEVEMENTS TO UNLOCK

items.title: Demon Teens
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Feel demonic, come out from the depths and show your horns. Play as one of those teenagers from the Demon Teens skin pack, they are just waiting for you!

+ 15 skins
